players.name: Joe Milton III
wk: Joseph Jay Milton III is an American professional football quarterback for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Michigan Wolverines and Tennessee Volunteers before being selected by the New England Patriots in the sixth round of the 2024 NFL draft. He has also played for the Dallas Cowboys.

players.name: Tanner McKee
wk: Tanner Jeremie McKee is an American professional football quarterback for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal and was selected by the Eagles in the sixth round of the 2023 NFL draft.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
wk: Jalen Alexander Hurts is an American professional football quarterback for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He began his college football career with the Alabama Crimson Tide, leading the team to consecutive College Football Playoff National Championship appearances in 2016 and 2017. After three seasons at Alabama, Hurts used his final year of eligibility with the Oklahoma Sooners and made an appearance in the 2019–20 College Football Playoff.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
wk: DeVonta Versean Smith is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, where he recorded 1,856 yards with 23 touchdowns as a senior in 2020. Smith was awarded the Heisman Trophy for his accomplishments as a senior alongside several other awards and honors. He was the first wide receiver to win the Heisman since Desmond Howard in 1991 and only the fourth overall. Smith won two national championships at Alabama prior to being selected by the Eagles tenth overall in the 2021 NFL draft. In his fourth season with the Eagles, Smith won Super Bowl LIX, becoming the fifth football player to win the Super Bowl, a college national title, and the Heisman Trophy.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
wk: Dontayvion Jaquain Wicks is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers, and was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fifth round of the 2023 NFL draft.

players.name: Makai Lemon
wk: Makai Lemon is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the USC Trojans, winning the 2025 Fred Biletnikoff Award, and was selected by the Eagles in the first round of the 2026 NFL draft.

players.name: Dameon Pierce
wk: Dameon Pierce is an American professional football running back. He played college football for the Florida Gators and was selected by the Houston Texans in the fourth round of the 2022 NFL draft. He has also played for the Philadelphia Eagles and the Kansas City Chiefs of the National Football League.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
wk: Dallas Christopher Goedert is an American professional football tight end for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the South Dakota State Jackrabbits, and was selected by the Eagles in the second round of the 2018 NFL draft.

players.name: Darius Cooper
wk: Darius Cooper is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Tarleton State Texans and was signed by the Eagles as an undrafted free agent in 2025.

players.name: Marquise Brown
wk: Marquise Brown is an American professional football wide receiver. Nicknamed "Hollywood", he played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners, receiving first-team All-American honors in 2018. Brown was selected in the first round of the 2019 NFL draft by the Baltimore Ravens, where he spent his first three seasons. He has also been a member of the Arizona Cardinals and Kansas City Chiefs for two seasons each, and of the Philadelphia Eagles.

players.name: Elijah Mitchell
wk: Elijah I. Mitchell is an American professional football running back for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the sixth round of the 2021 NFL draft. Mitchell has also been a member of the Kansas City Chiefs and New England Patriots.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
wk: Saquon Rasul Quevis Barkley is an American professional football running back for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Penn State Nittany Lions, where he set several school records for his offensive production over three seasons before forgoing his senior year to enter the NFL.

players.name: Johnny Mundt
wk: John Christian Mundt is an American professional football tight end for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon Ducks.

players.name: Will Shipley
wk: William L. Shipley is an American professional football running back and kickoff returner for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Clemson Tigers.

players.name: Tank Bigsby
wk: Cartavious "Tank" Bigsby is an American professional football running back and kickoff returner for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Auburn Tigers and was selected by the Jacksonville Jaguars in the third round of the 2023 NFL draft. He was traded to the Eagles in 2025.

players.name: Zach Ertz
wk: Zachary Adam Ertz is an American professional football tight end for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal and was selected by the Philadelphia Eagles in the second round of the 2013 NFL draft. Ertz played nine seasons with the Eagles, making three Pro Bowls and winning Super Bowl LII with them. He set the NFL record for most receptions in a season by a tight end in 2018, which stood until eclipsed by Trey McBride in 2025. Ertz has also been a member of the Arizona Cardinals, Detroit Lions, and Washington Commanders. His wife Julie is a former player for the U.S. national soccer team.

players.name: Elijah Moore
wk: Elijah Danilo Moore is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels and was selected by the New York Jets in the second round of the 2021 NFL draft. He has also played for the Cleveland Browns, Buffalo Bills, and Denver Broncos.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.col: Vanderbilt; New Mexico State; Texas A&M
wk: Elijah Stowers is an American professional football tight end for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies, New Mexico State Aggies, and Vanderbilt Commodores, winning the 2025 John Mackey Award with Vanderbilt before being selected by the Eagles in the second round of the 2026 NFL draft.

players.name: Grant Calcaterra
wk: Grant Calcaterra is an American professional football tight end for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners before transferring to the SMU Mustangs.

players.name: Jaydon Blue
wk: Jaydon Blue is an American professional football running back. He played college football for the Texas Longhorns and was selected by the Cowboys in the fifth round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Britain Covey
wk: Britain Covey is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Utah Utes and was signed by the Philadelphia Eagles as an undrafted free agent in 2022.
